card.name: Roda
card.tagline: Ambiguous 'circle'; best-supported referent is Samba de Roda.
card.profile: 'Roda' means circle/wheel and is ambiguous: it can denote the capoeira roda or, most defensibly as a dance, Samba de Roda of the Reconcavo of Bahia - a music-dance-poetry tradition from 17th-century Bahia drawing on enslaved Africans' traditions plus Portuguese elements. Performers form a circle (roda); a soloist dances in the center using the umbigada (belly-bump) to invite a successor, with footwork, leg and hip movements, accompanied by atabaque, berimbau, pandeiro, chocalho, singing and clapping (UNESCO; English Wikipedia).
card.insight: Samba de Roda was proclaimed a UNESCO Masterpiece in 2005 and inscribed on the Representative List in 2008 (file 00101); it influenced the urban samba that became a Brazilian national symbol (UNESCO).
